card.title: Affiliate program
card.body: Share the pieces you love and earn a commission on every order your link brings in.

account.title: Become an affiliate
account.intro: Recommend us to your audience and earn on the orders you send our way.
account.point1: Get your own referral link and QR code, with sub-IDs to see what works.
account.point2: Follow clicks, orders and earnings in your affiliate dashboard.
account.point3: Earnings are confirmed once the return window has passed.
account.termsOutdated: Our affiliate terms have changed. Accept the new terms in your dashboard to keep earning.

PENDING.label: Under review
PENDING.body: Thanks for applying. We review every application and will email you once we've decided.

ACTIVE.label: Active
ACTIVE.body: You're an affiliate. Make links, follow your results and see your earnings in the dashboard.

SUSPENDED.label: Suspended
SUSPENDED.body: Your affiliate account is suspended for now. Contact us if you have questions.

REJECTED.label: Not approved
REJECTED.body: We weren't able to approve your application this time. Contact us if you have questions.

website.label: Website or social profile
website.hint: Where you'll share your links, for example instagram.com/yourname.

audience_size.label: Audience size
audience_size.hint: Roughly how many followers, subscribers or monthly visitors you have.

promotion_methods.label: How will you promote us?
promotion_methods.hint: For example reviews, styling videos or a newsletter.

terms.title: Accept the updated affiliate terms
terms.body: Our affiliate terms have changed. Accept the new terms to see your dashboard and keep earning.

errors.termsRequired: Accept the affiliate terms to continue.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.APPLY_FAILED: We couldn't send your application. Please try again.
errors.TERMS_FAILED: We couldn't record your acceptance. Please try again.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELDS_INVALID: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: The affiliate program isn't open right now.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The affiliate program isn't open right now.
errors.walletNumberInvalid: Enter an 11-digit Bangladeshi mobile number, for example 01712345678.
errors.accountNumberInvalid: Enter the account number using digits only (6 to 20 digits).
errors.PAYOUT_METHOD_INVALID: We couldn't check that account. Check the number and try again.
errors.PAYOUT_METHOD_FAILED: We couldn't save your payout method. Please try again.
errors.PAYOUT_METHOD_GONE: That payout method has already been removed.
errors.TOO_MANY_METHODS: You can save up to 5 payout methods. Remove one to add another.
errors.PAYOUT_BELOW_MINIMUM: Your balance ready for payout is below the minimum payout amount.
errors.NO_PAYOUT_METHOD: Add a payout method before asking for a payout.
errors.PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS: You already have a payout in progress. You can ask for the next one once it's paid.
errors.PAYOUT_SCHEDULED: Payouts are sent on a schedule, so they can't be requested right now.
errors.PAYOUT_REQUEST_FAILED: We couldn't send your payout request. Please try again.
errors.ASSET_GONE: This asset is no longer available.
errors.ASSET_FAILED: We couldn't get your link. Please try again.

overview.pendingNote: Waiting for the return window to pass
overview.subIdsCaption: Clicks, orders and conversion rate for each sub-ID over the last {days} days.
overview.noActivityDays: No clicks or orders in the last {days} days. Share a link to get started.

links.title: Make a link
links.intro: Pick a page, add a sub-ID if you want to tell your channels apart, then copy the link or save the QR code.
links.noCodes: You don't have an active referral code yet.
links.label: Label
links.pageHint: A page of the store, starting with /, for example /products/leather-weekender-bag. Leave empty for the home page.
links.pageInvalid: Use a page of this store, starting with /.
links.subIdHint: A tag for where you share the link, for example instagram-bio. Shown in your stats.
links.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
links.qrCaption: Scanning this code opens your link.

orders.title: Attributed orders
orders.privacy: Orders your links brought in. Shopper details are never shown.
orders.empty: No orders yet. They show up here once someone orders through your link.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.intro: Every commission, adjustment and reversal on your account.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: Payouts of your approved cash earnings.

copy.failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

tier.title: Your tier
tier.none: You don't have a tier yet.
tier.tiered: Commission that rises with your sales
tier.progress: {sales} of {target} in sales over the last {days} days
tier.toGo: {amount} more in sales to get there.
tier.reached: You've reached it. Your tier is updated at the next review.
tier.top: You're on the top tier, with {sales} in sales over the last {days} days.

coupons.title: Your coupon codes
coupons.intro: Share these codes with your audience. When a shopper uses one at checkout, the order is credited to you.
coupons.empty: You don't have any coupon codes yet. Ask us if you'd like one for your audience.

methods.title: Payout methods
methods.intro: Where we send your payouts. Payouts go to your default method. For your security we only ever show the last 4 digits of an account.
methods.empty: You haven't added a payout method yet. Add one below so we can pay you.
methods.limit: You've saved the maximum of {max} payout methods. Remove one to add another.

bank.label: Bank account
bank.hint: Transfer to a Bangladeshi bank account

methods.walletNumberHint: The mobile number of your personal wallet account, for example 01712345678.
methods.bankNameHint: For example City Bank or Dutch-Bangla Bank.
methods.routingNumberHint: 9 digits. You can find it on a cheque or ask your branch.
methods.accountNameHint: As it appears on the account.
methods.makeDefault: Use this for my payouts (make it the default)
methods.privacy: Account details are stored encrypted. After saving you'll only see the last 4 digits.
methods.editNote: To change the account or wallet number, add the new account and remove this one.
methods.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? You can add it again later.
methods.removeDefaultConfirm: Remove {name}? It's your default; your oldest remaining method becomes the default.

request.title: Request a payout

schedule.weekly: Payouts are sent every week: we pay your approved balance to your default payout method, no request needed.
schedule.monthly: Payouts are sent every month: we pay your approved balance to your default payout method, no request needed.
schedule.on_request: Ask for a payout whenever your balance reaches the minimum.

request.inProgress: A payout of {amount} is in progress. You can ask for the next one once it's paid.
request.needMethod: Add a payout method before asking for a payout.
request.belowMinimum: You need {amount} more in approved earnings to reach the minimum payout.
request.nothingPayable: You don't have approved earnings ready for payout yet.
request.requested: Payout requested. We'll let you know once it's been sent.

assets.title: Marketing assets
assets.intro: Banners, product images and ready-made posts. Download them, or get your tracked link so every click and order is credited to you.
assets.empty: No marketing assets yet. Check back soon.
assets.statsNote: Each download or tracked link you get is counted for that asset.

closed.title: Our affiliate program isn’t open yet
closed.body: We’re not taking affiliate applications right now. Please check back soon — we’ll announce it here when the program opens.
